definitions.scope: campaigns with a contestant count (100 or more contestants), plausible start dates, every group at least five organizers
definitions.completions_per_contestant: entry_count divided by contestants. entry_count is the number of completions of the action, not worth-weighted: per campaign the sum of entry_count equals valid entries within 8% whether or not any action carries a worth above one, while the worth-weighted sum runs five times higher. Worth changes what an entrant is credited, never the count
definitions.share_click_ratio: viral share clicks over impressions, summed per campaign then the median across campaigns with a share action
definitions.by_band_all: every band including 100 to 1,000, across every campaign at the floor before the crypto, ambiguous and purchase-only exclusions. Its total is far above the ordinary population, so quote by_band beside any other figure in this file and keep by_band_all for questions about the whole platform
definitions.by_band: the six size bands on the ordinary population, the same campaigns as every other cut in this file
definitions.worth_bands_by_action: optional actions only, completions per contestant by the worth the organizer set, with the campaign's entries per entrant and conversion alongside; mandatory actions excluded because they complete regardless of worth
definitions.config_cuts: completions per contestant by action settings read from the action config JSON. n counts Actions, one row per Action offered, never campaigns
definitions.promotion_sites: third-party sites that sent visitors, by channel, with the impressions they sent and the campaigns and organizers they reached (at least five organizers per site), for the promotion plan's listing advice
definitions.referrer_channel_share: referrer hosts classified by an assistant into channels (the top 400 hosts, which carry 90% of referred impressions), the rest by pattern, the remainder unclassified_tail
definitions.channel_quantity_vs_quality: outcomes_when_channel_over_10pct with the channel's share of all impressions in the dataset alongside it, so a channel that sends a lot of traffic but converts, emails or refers it poorly reads as a tradeoff rather than a failure
definitions.channel_quality_by_size_band: outcomes_when_channel_over_10pct split by contestant band, to check whether a channel's conversion and entries-per-entrant ranking against other channels holds once organizer size is controlled for, or whether it is really a size effect
definitions.email_traffic_by_provider: impressions whose landing URL carries an email UTM tag, grouped by the provider named in utm_source. This is the organizer's own mass mail reaching the campaign page, never anything Gleam sent, and only 11% of impressions carry a UTM tag at all
definitions.outcomes_when_email_over_10pct: campaigns where tagged email impressions are a tenth or more of all impressions, against campaigns with no tagged email impressions at all
definitions.viral_click_conversion_excluding_crypto: the same cut with finance_crypto organizers removed. Crypto campaigns run referral farms, so they lift the pooled figure well above what an ordinary organizer sees
definitions.viral_click_conversion: a viral share click is a click on one entrant's own share link. Referrals are completions of the share action, which Gleam credits when a referred person enters. referrals_per_click is the median across campaigns of referrals over clicks, so it reads as the share of clicks on a shared link that ended in an entry. campaign_conversion_same_campaigns is contestants per impression on the same campaigns, for comparison
definitions.uptake_by_family_and_position: completions per contestant by action family and list position (position is zero-indexed in the dataset, 1st is position 0). n counts Actions, one row per Action offered, so it runs above the campaign population and must never be printed under a Campaigns heading; sites counts the businesses behind them
definitions.by_method_count_clean: clean campaigns (no repeatable action, 14 days or less) by action count
definitions.by_description_length: clean campaigns by word count of the campaign description
definitions.actions_vs_baseline: each Action against the campaigns in the same subset that did not offer it, on the fair-comparison subset (no repeatable Action, a run of 14 days or less). Medians across campaigns. It describes what businesses chose, never what an Action caused, and a business that reaches a big crowd is also the sort to offer more Actions
